original_entry_principle: Open FINAL only after one champion and at most two challengers are frozen from TRAIN/DEV.
reason: The corrected TRAIN/DEV programme exhausted the serious structural and dynamic lanes without a gate-passing candidate. FINAL was therefore not launched.

preserved_rules.chronology: Strict block-prior visibility for target-state models; source-shock timing strictly before target response.
preserved_rules.no_post_dev_replacement: No challenger may be invented from FINAL.
preserved_rules.execution_boundary: Historical fills are repricing observations, not proof of executable arbitrage or maker P&L.

future_rule: R3-FV-001 is closed. Do not launch its staged FINAL evaluator. A genuinely new preregistered programme may preserve and later use the untouched holdout.
